# Unified hypothesis: each copy is an independent object; the OUTPUT marks, for every row,
# the cells that belong to one copy but stick out past the other copy's right edge, filled 1.
# Equivalently: global max extent mx; for each row, mark with 1 all cells right of the row's

# demo 4 disproves plain global-fill: upper rows (11-13) have no 1s even though max col overall =9.
# So it's pairwise: within each pair of stacked copies (offset by constant), compare rows side by side,
# mark the EXTRA cells of the larger/sticker copy as 1, keeping others. Verify this generalizes.
def f(g):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]; H=len(g); W=len(g[0]); bgc=g[0][0]
    nz=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j,x in enumerate(r if False else g[i]) if x!=bgc]
    rows_fg=[i for i,_ in nz]
    # group rows into contiguous copy-groups split by all-empty rows
    groups=[]; cur=[rows_fg[0]]
    for i in rows_fg[1:]:
        if i==cur[-1]+1: cur.append(i)
        else: groups.append(cur); cur=[i]
    groups.append(cur)
    # assume exactly 2 groups per demo... demo5 has 3? rows 0,7,9 not contiguous -> separate groups; treat each pair
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    for grp in groups:
        a=min(grp); b=max(grp)
        lo=a-highest=grp[0]
        ref=grps[0]  # reference group = first group
        for i in grp:
            j=(i-grp[0])+ref[0]
            nza=[k for k in range(W) if g[i][k]!=bgc]
            if nza: h=max(nza)
            ref_row = g[j]
            ref_nz=[k for k in range(W) if ref_row[k]!=bgc]
            if ref_nz: refh=max(ref_nz)
            for k in range(h+1, refh+1):
                out[i][k]=1
    return out

            for j in range(out[i].index(max(g[i]))+1,mx+1):

    return out

    # find all maximal runs of foreground rows forming "blocks" separated by all-bg rows
    # identify repeated copies: for each row-block start, find dy to next similar block via min column-displacement offset (dx unknown yet)
    fg=[i for i,r_ in enumerate(g) if any(x!=bg for x in r_)]
    blocks=[];cur=[fg[0]]
    for i in fg[1:]:
        if i==cur[-1]+1: cur.append(i)
        else: blocks.append(cur);cur=[i]
    blocks.append(cur)
    print('blocks',blocks,'H,W',H,W)
    return out

import os,glob,re,json
def loadf(p):
    t=open(p).read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):

def solve(a):
    H=len(a); W=len(a[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for r in a for v in r)
    bg=max(cnt,key=lambda v:cnt[v]); fg=sorted(set(v for r in a for v in r)-{bg})[0]
    rows=[r for r in range(H) if any(a[r][c]!=bg for c in range(W))]
    ub=[r for r in rows[:len(rows)//2]]; lb=[r for r in rows[len(rows)//2:]]
    tb=set((u,c) for u in ub for c in range(W) if a[u][c]==fg)
    ob=set((l,c) for l in lb for c in range(W) if a[l][c]==fg)
    best=None
    for s in range(W):
        ts={(c+s)%W for (u,c) in tb}
        sc=s if (ob-ts)==set() and ts-subset(ob|set()) else None
        ov=len(ts&ob); score=(ov,-len(ts-ob))
        if best is None or score>best[0]: best=(score,s)
    return best,tb,ob,bg,fg
for i in [1,2,3,4]:
    a=G[f'Demo pair {i} input']; b=G[f'Demo pair {i} output']
    H=len(a); W=len(a[0])
